verdict: Paid channels are dark; Google Business Profile is holding the line.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, every engagement came from Google Business Profiles — no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads for the full 28 days. Combined, your three profiles drove 399 total actions (28 calls, 246 direction requests, and 125 website clicks), which shows real market interest even without paid support. Over the last 7 days, however, GBP activity declined at all three locations — most sharply at O'Hare Precision, down 46% week over week — signaling that organic visibility alone is beginning to soften. CRM setup work that was due in July is being completed now, and that foundation is required before paid campaigns can be rebuilt and relaunched. Once those milestones are cleared, paid channels will be reactivated and lead flow will resume; the next meaningful inflection point is end of August.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all locations in the last 28 days — calls, direction requests, and website clicks combined
inbound calls received across all three locations this period, entirely through organic profile activity

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement is declining week over week at all three locations, with no paid campaigns active to offset the softness.
watch_item.fix: CRM and outreach groundwork is being finalized by end of August, clearing the path to relaunch paid campaigns and stabilize lead flow into September.
